## Rule

4-fold rotational tile on 2x2 or 3x3 inputs. The output is the input quilted into a 2x2 square of rotations:
TL=input, TR=90 CW, BL=90 CCW, BR=180. The current team-best formulation assumes active colors are 1..9 and
selects between fixed 4x4/6x6 source maps for the 2x2/3x3 cases.

## Algorithm sketch

Reference recipe: `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-task106-4fold-rotation-tile.md`.

Candidate `conv_noch0_v1` keeps Aditya's fixed-map formulation but lowers the selector:
crop `input[:,1:10,:3,:3]`, compute color ids with 1x1 Conv weights 1..9, flatten to 9 ids, gather both
2x2 and 3x3 36-cell quilts, `Where` the uint8 values using bottom-right-present, reshape to 6x6,
compare against colors 1..9, then final Pad prepends channel 0 and pads to 30x30.

## Cost analysis

Team-best source of truth is `K-NeuroGolf-OnnxlyFans/Team_Submission/Backend/manifest.csv`:
Boladi cost 718, SHA `1816f820efec288c3f84d12f6961084723a59cdf065af2e919ab7cf6d857ed2b`.

Staged `sharedsel_w106` costs 628 = memory 452 + params 176; profile real cost is also 628.
It is byte-equal to the 718 team-best and only removes the duplicate square-axis selector: `sel3 [30,3]`
feeds both the row and column selector operands of `Einsum("bchw,c,hr,ws->brs")`.
Dominant charged tensors remain `channels` INT32 `[1,1,6,6]` 144 B, `updates` F32 `[1,1,6,6]` 144 B,
and three U8 6x6 branch tensors (`channels2`, `channels3`, `channels_u8`) at 36 B each.

## Don't-do log

- Do not re-select between full int32 36-cell maps after the branch test; gather both uint8 quilts first and `Where` values.
- Do not append a sentinel to the 9-cell flat color vector for 2x2 padding; map off-output cells to crop index 2, which is zero in the 2x2 branch.
- Do not compute channel 0 in the 6x6 one-hot plane for this formulation; task106 generator uses active colors 1..9 and final Pad can prepend false channel 0.
- Do not store separate row/column selector matrices for a square top-left tile basis-Einsum; the same `[30,3]` selector can feed both operands.
